references.text: Jesus gives similar instructions to his disciples in the Gospel of Luke, where he also says they should not take money, a bag, or extra sandals.
In Matthew's version of the sending out of the twelve, Jesus gives similar instructions not to acquire gold, silver, or copper for their money belts.
When Paul and Barnabas were sent out by the Holy Spirit, they also went without taking extra supplies, trusting in God's provision.
